verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe a built-in assistant you can delegate to. You can 'Ask Rippling' about devices, threats, or compliance gaps, and its AI surfaces answers, automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports. You can also 'Tell Rippling what you need' and agents handle device ordering, routing, retrieval, and retirement, and 'Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data' is a listed feature. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the assistant's scope, permissions, and approval controls, and independent or hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks actually execute end-to-end (current evidence is marketing copy only).
